=Tutorial=
*The player is made familiar with radars
*Walrus armor
= Objectives =
#FRONTIER FACILITIES
#*We still barely have any equipment. If we take Frontier, perhaps it would change the situation.
#DESTROY THE RADAR INSTALLATION (optional)
#*Destroy the enemy radar system, doing so will prevent enemy units from receiving advanced warning of our unit movements.
#RETRIEVE THE ARMOR
#*Locate and retrieve the Medium Armor upgrade for the Walrus. According to data in the Command Center's database, it was developed at the island's Unit Production Facilities.
#TAKE THE COMMAND CENTER
#*Reprogram the Command Center to take control of the island.
#REPAIR THE COMMAND CENTER
#*Find a way to rebuild or repair the Command Center. There must be a backup plan in the event of its destruction.
